com.mobybank.harness.application
The use cases.

The PostgreSQL implementations of the repository ports, written with Hibernate ORM and Panache.

The HTTP surface: JAX-RS resources, request bodies, and the exception mappers that turn failures into error responses.

The HTML endpoints behind index.html, the htmx page served at /.
